title: Thimsy emulator_config/devices/<id>/picks.json
description: One device's emulator picks, per system and per game (OA-46; LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.25; per_device_config_plan.md 2.2). Written only by the device whose set it is; merged per entry with the device's local picks, the card's entry winning a clash. A system is listed only where its pick differs from the device's image default. Thimsy-new file: strict at the top, open per entry, so a newer writer's fields survive. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

systems.description: Keyed by the system's id in nano/systems.json (nes, psx, n64).

games.description: Keyed by the game key, form (c): the ES-DE folder, '/', the path relative to it, case kept, no './'.

system_pick.description: The launch fields' own names, as nano/systems.json and nano_systems.json spell them.

key.description: The portable key of the same pick; informative only.

label.description: Nano's display label of the emulator.

am.description: Android am start arguments; empty on Linux.

key.description: The portable key of the same pick; informative only.
